# semaphore_ex_project_workflow_retry_reconcile (Action)

Retries workflow reconciliation and clears its retry/quarantine state. Finished runs remain unchanged. Executes only through explicit Action invocation. Progress reports a bounded, non-secret summary.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "semaphore_ex_project_workflow_retry_reconcile" "example" {
  config {
    project_id  = 1
    workflow_id = 2
    run_id      = 3
  }
}

# terraform apply -invoke=action.semaphore_ex_project_workflow_retry_reconcile.example
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (Number)
- `run_id` (Number)
- `workflow_id` (Number)
